label: TMUA 2023 · Paper 1 · Question 7

hints.title: Write an equation for the ratio
hints.body: Translate the ordered ratio into one equality between P and Q before substituting their expressions.
hints.recap: A ratio A:B=r:1 means A=rB, provided the ratio is defined.
hints.pitfall: Reversing the ratio swaps the two quantities.
hints.pause: Form the equality in the stated order.

recall.reminder: A ratio A:B=r:1 means A=rB, provided the ratio is defined.

hints.title: Use one positive variable
hints.body: Name the repeated power 2x as a new variable. Rewrite every other power of two using index laws.
hints.recap: A repeated exponential can be replaced by a positive variable to expose a quadratic.
hints.pitfall: Subtracting in an exponent divides by a power; it does not subtract outside the power.
hints.pause: Solve the resulting polynomial and retain permitted values of the new variable.

recall.reminder: A repeated exponential can be replaced by a positive variable to expose a quadratic.

hints.title: Undo the substitution in the right order
hints.body: Recover x from each permitted exponential value and use monotonicity to compare the results.
hints.recap: For a base greater than one, the larger exponential output comes from the larger input.
hints.pitfall: Check that the original denominator of a ratio is nonzero.
hints.pause: Verify the ratio and choose the largest original input.

recall.reminder: For a base greater than one, the larger exponential output comes from the larger input.

solution:
1. Translate the ratio. P(x):Q(x)=4:1 gives P(x)=4Q(x). Put u=2x>0. Then P=u+4 and Q=u2/4−4u+16.

2. Solve. u+4=u2−16u+64, so u2−17u+60=(u−5)(u−12)=0. Both positive roots are allowed.

3. Return to x. The inputs are log25 and log212. Since base 2 is greater than one, the larger is log212. At each root Q=P/4>0, so the original ratio is defined. Answer F.
knowledgePattern: Convert the ratio to a quadratic in a positive exponential
